subject: bat hawk
title: This Hawk Swallows Bats Whole in Mid-Air, and Gets 30 Minutes to Do It

scenes.text: This hawk gets about half an hour to hunt each day.
The bat hawk waits for dusk, when bats pour out of their caves.
It chases them at high speed and snatches them out of the air with its feet.
Then it swallows each bat whole, without ever landing.
Its mouth is unusually wide for a bird of prey, so a bat goes straight down.
That's how it fits its whole day's food into half an hour. It never stops to eat.

description:
The bat hawk hunts in a window of about half an hour at dusk, when bats leave their roosts.
It catches them in flight and swallows them whole without landing, helped by an unusually wide mouth.
What would you do with only thirty minutes to eat each day?
first_comment: In Asia, where there are fewer bats, it also hunts swiftlets and swallows, and keeps going longer. Which would you rather watch, the bats or the hawk?
